signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and inside the numbers
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers
Running backs with this ability have better catch in traffic and route running when coming out of the backfield against linebackers and linemen.
Kickers with this ability experience a slower kicking meter for better power and accuracy on kicks over 45 yards.
The game's top defenders excel in all situations. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance of defeating run blocks, and disrupting catches via tackles.
Defenders with this ability have an increased success rate when using conservative or diving tackles.
Defenders with this ability are highly likely to force catch knockouts against running backs.
Defenders with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against receivers, tight ends, and running backs.
Ballcarriers with this ability will break almost any hit-stick tackle attempts made on them.
Avoid stumbling when carrying the ball
Ballcarriers with this ability are effective at recovering from attempted tackles regardless of their current stamina.
Vanguard players are the reason running backs thank their blockers in the postgame interview. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed dominant impact block wins.
